summary: Freeze SourceDAO release configuration and publish bootstrap evidence separately from private recovery state
details: Freeze reviewed candidates with source provenance, explicit parameter overrides, reviewed golden and synchronized bundle hashes; promote into the release workspace with a rollback copy.
Execute bootstrap and validation from frozen bundle configuration and package only declared public inputs in the node kit.
Provide a dedicated bootstrap tools image and private-key file injection while keeping configuration and recovery storage outside the image.
Export deterministic public deployment records and bind their exact bytes to acceptance while preserving private signed transaction journals for recovery.
Share one pinned source import across target networks; keep source RPC/checkpoint defaults in public source configuration and preserve immutable source evidence references in editable candidates.

Prepare and freeze candidates using network-specific default directories, and execute bootstrap/export/strict validation with default localhost RPC and separate identity-scoped private/public storage.
Reuse existing default validation checkpoints without rewriting evidence and expose resolved artifact paths for downstream acceptance.
operator_actions: For a new SourceDAO bootstrap, review and freeze the public configuration before publishing the release, then use the bundle directory at execution time.
Export public state before strict validation and acceptance. Publish that public record and retain the original state and transaction journal in private backup storage.
